messages:
Ava: Quick sync — product benchmark webinar + launch email plan. Need a tight 3-email microdrip for webinar signups, segmented by company size (1-10 / 11-200 / 200+). Also APAC send windows and subject line variants. Drop availability and any blockers? cc @Priya

Diego: On it. Proposal: Starter (1-10) = short wins + trial CTA; Growth (11-200) = case studies + pricing tease; Enterprise (200+) = invite to dedicated demo. I can build the segment queries today.

Priya: APAC note — ideal local send window is 08:00-10:00 SGT. For APAC registrants move Send #1 earlier by ~8-12 hours vs NA. Need JP/KR translations for copy and subject lines — can we get base copy by Wed so localization team has 48 hrs?

Sam: Counts: Starter ~4.2k, Growth ~1.1k, Enterprise ~320. Deliverability plan: seed tests -> 2-day ramp -> full ramp. Recommend 15-min stagger for large batches on dedicated IP.

Lily: Subject ideas (short):
- "See Redwood's latency benchmark"
- "How we cut inference costs by 3x"
- "Webinar recap + benchmarking highlights"
A/B test first two for Starter/Growth. Enterprise: single invite subject: "Schedule a private demo: benchmarking results". Also swap 'trial' -> 'sandbox' for Enterprise copy.

Ava: Actions: A) A/B subject lines for Starter & Growth, single for Enterprise; B) Diego — add final segment filters + send lists to the doc; C) Sam — run seed at T-48 and monitoring plan; D) Priya — localization deadline Wed.

Diego: Added segment filters and query snippet to the private doc: https://docs.redwood.xyz/marketing/webinar-seg. Snippet: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE company_size <= 10 AND email_opt_in = true;

Schedule (draft): 1) Seed test: Thu 10:00 PT -> 100 internal + engaged addresses; 2) Day 0 send: Fri 09:00 PT (Starter A) / 09:15 PT (Starter B); 3) Day 2 follow-up: Sun 09:00 PT (all cohorts); 4) Enterprise demo invites: Mon 10:00 PT (manual QA + human send).

LaunchBot: Reminder: Email QA meeting Wed 14:00 PT. Invite sent. :calendar:

Sam: Will run deliverability checklist and provide ramp report after seed. :thumbsup:

Ava: I'll consolidate into the launch playbook and post updates in the doc. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
